deliverables.change: New. Draft access: member role via workspaces index, matter visibility like research/notes-service.ts, `can()` checks for draft.read/draft.write/draft.export; clerk denied (NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN per matter-service convention).

New. createDraft, renderDraft (loads facts through matter-graph index only, resolveBlocks, no narrative calls unless port given), saveVersion (canonical-JSON sha256 into draft_version.content_sha256, next version_no), listVersions, restoreVersion (new version copying old content), exportDraft (permission check, enqueue `drafting.export`; returns existing export when present). Never logs draft text.

New. runDraftingExport({db,store,keys,log,now}, payload): idempotent on (draft_version_id, format): return the existing draft_export row if present; else render docx/pdf via @causedeck/drafting (block on MissingSlotsError), put to storage key objectKey kind 'export' under ws/<workspaceId>/ with envelope encryption (same keys/store usage as lifecycle/export), insert draft_export with exported_at, record audit `draft.exported` (actor, format, version content hash). `createDraftExportDownload` returns presigned GET only (createDownloadUrl). No email/share function. Narrative calls via createAiPorts so refused non-India calls write ai_call rows.
New. Public exports of the service functions and types only.

New. defineJob `drafting.export` (zod payload {workspaceId, draftVersionId, format: ExportFormat}); singleton and idempotencyKey `${draftVersionId}:${format}`; handler calls runDraftingExport; pattern from export-build.ts.
Wiring only: import and register draftingExport (3 spots like exportBuild at :48,:187,:247).

Add dependency `@causedeck/drafting: workspace:*` (core uses the engine to render; docs/engineering/13-technical-architecture-spike.md:94 lists drafting in core's dependencies) and exports entry `./drafting`.
Add `export * from './drafting/index.ts';`.

Add `drafting` domain (CORE_DOMAINS list as the file requires) with CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES entry: workspaces, matter-graph, audit (plus usage/ai only if imported, via their index.ts); add 'drafting' to the jobs dependency list; keep acyclic.
Add drafting row to the domain table, the dependency graph edges and dependency table, and jobs row, matching D9.

Add tenantTable `draft_export` (id, draft_version_id, format text check in pdf/docx, storage_key, size_bytes, exported_at timestamptz not null, created_by nullable, composite FK (workspace_id, draft_version_id) to draft_version, unique (draft_version_id, format), workspace FK cascade) following the existing tables' conventions.

Add next free-numbered migration SQL (after 20261025060000_drafting.sql) creating draft_export with forced RLS keyed on app.workspace_id, regenerated snapshot/journal in migrations/meta; renumber if the base took the slot.

decisions.choice: New table `draft_export` instead of a column on draft_version
decisions.justification: draft_version is immutable by trigger (packages/db/src/schema/drafting.ts:8-10, only created_by may change), so exported_at and the stored file key cannot live there; unique (draft_version_id, format) gives the idempotency key

decisions.choice: Add policy actions draft.read and draft.export (junior, matter-scoped) rather than reuse draft.write
decisions.justification: matrix.ts:30 has only draft.write; the issue requires can(user,'draft:*') with clerk restrictions; juniors and up, clerks denied, mirrors memory.read/write (research/notes-service.ts:1-8)
docs/engineering/13-technical-architecture-spike.md:94 lists drafting among core's dependencies; apps/web already depends on it

decisions.choice: Reuse storage kind 'export' and the export-build store/keys wiring
decisions.justification: packages/storage/src/limits.ts:13 SERVER_OBJECT_KINDS includes 'export'; jobs/definitions/export-build.ts:36-49 shows createObjectStoreFromEnv and EnvKeyProvider usage
